ios.desc:
Eight games. One delightfully simple arcade.

Really Simple Arcade brings together familiar classics and small, playful ideas without ads, tracking, accounts, or unnecessary complications. Download the app for free and start with two included games, then add optional two-game packs whenever you want more.

INCLUDED FREE

• One in a Million
Find the single orange hiding in a sea of bananas. It sounds easy—until you see just how many bananas there are.

• Simon Says
Watch the sequence, remember the pattern, and see how long you can keep up with this colorful memory classic.

GAME PACK ONE

• Card Match
Match all 24 cards in a clean, classic game of memory.

• Triangle Solitaire
Jump the circles until only one remains in this familiar puzzle, also known as Peg Solitaire or Hi-Q.

GAME PACK TWO

• Snake
Play Snake like it’s 1997, with touch and swipe controls on iPhone plus keyboard support on iPad.

• Tic-Tac-Toe
Play against Easy, Hard, or Impossible computer opponents, or share the device for a two-player game.

GAME PACK THREE

• Battleship
Place your fleet, choose your targets, and battle a local computer opponent in a complete single-player naval strategy game.

• Neko Jump
Run through a monochrome pixel kitchen as a cat, jumping over pancake stacks and ducking under seagulls in a fast, silly endless runner.

Every game is designed to be quick to understand and easy to revisit. Game packs are non-consumable purchases and support Family Sharing.

No ads. No tracking. No account. Just simple games and simple fun.
